brandColor.heading: Brand color
brandColor.description: Your primary color — drives buttons, links, and highlights across the learner app and admin dashboard.

font.heading: Font
font.description: The typeface used across the learner app and admin dashboard.

background.heading: Page background
background.description: The canvas behind your content — white by default in both apps. Cards and menus stay white, so a light brand tint reads as a subtle wash.
background.tooDarkWarning: This is dark for a page background — body text stays dark, so it may be hard to read. Pick a lighter tint.
background.cardPreviewSubtitle: Stays white on the tinted page.

accentColors.heading: Secondary & tertiary colors
accentColors.description: Supporting accent colors used across the learner app (badges, secondary highlights). Auto-generated from your brand color unless you set one here — the admin dashboard doesn't use these.
accentColors.autoDerived: Auto — derived from your brand color.

sidebar.heading: Sidebar color
sidebar.description: Give your sidebar its own look, independent of the brand color — like Slack's sidebar themes.

learnerUi.heading: Learner app appearance
learnerUi.description: Shape, spacing and surface style for the learner app. These apply to what your learners see — the admin dashboard is unaffected.

corners.label: Corner style
corners.help: How rounded cards, buttons and inputs are. Avatars and pills stay circular.

density.label: Density
density.help: Card padding, spacing between elements, and control height.

gradient.label: Surface style
gradient.help: How strongly brand gradients show on cards and banners.

skin.label: Theme skin
skin.help: The overall visual language of the learner app.
